text: DSH TurboAgent 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 网页客户端的模型接入插件：它注册隐藏的 TurboAgent 模型路由，并管理本机验证代理。选择模式后，可按 Flash、Pro 或 Vision 模型生成多个候选，由验证器选出结果；设置页可调整各模型候选数和推理强度，并查看本地验证轨迹。适合希望在 Harness 中启用多候选回答与自动比较的用户。需要在 Harness 配置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY，并使用 Windows 与 Python 环境。

DSH TurboAgent adds a hidden route and managed proxy to DeepSeek Harness. Its mode generates multiple Flash, Pro, or Vision candidates, then returns a verifier-selected answer. The settings panel adjusts candidate counts and reasoning effort. Requires DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, Windows, and Python.
想让 DeepSeek Harness 对同一个问题生成多个候选答案，再自动挑选较好的结果。
有没有办法给 Harness 的 Flash、Pro 和视觉模型加上候选比较？
我希望在 Harness 里切换到多答案验证模式，同时保留原来的模型选择。
想调整每种 DeepSeek 模型并发生成多少个候选。
怎么在 Harness 的设置页修改模型推理强度？
需要让带图片的问题也交给多个候选回答并由视觉模型复核。
I want my Harness model to produce several answers and have a verifier choose one.
How can I compare multiple candidates for DeepSeek text and image requests in Harness?
Let me tune candidate counts and reasoning effort from a Harness settings panel.
Keep the normal model picker while routing a selected session through best-of-N verification.
DSH TurboAgent 的功能「Flash 与 Pro 候选验证」：在可选模式下依据当前会话模型并发生成多个回答，再由验证器比较候选并返回选择结果。可分别设置 Flash、Pro 的候选数量。
DSH TurboAgent 的功能「视觉候选复核」：Vision 请求会提取输入中的图像，并将图像用于候选生成和视觉验证器评估，帮助比较针对同一图片的回答。
DSH TurboAgent 的功能「代理设置面板」：Harness 设置页展示代理状态，可调整 Flash、Pro、Vision 候选数及推理强度，保存后更新运行配置并提供本地验证轨迹链接。

@dsh-external/dsh-turbo-agent README · DSH TurboAgent：Managed, loopback-only [TurboAgent](https://github.com/llm-as-a-verifier/TurboAgent)
integration for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).
Tested with DeepSeek Harness `0.1.1-rc.2`, TurboAgent `0.2.1`, and
LLM-as-a-Verifier `0.2.0` on Windows.

@dsh-external/dsh-turbo-agent README · DSH TurboAgent：The plugin installs a selectable **TurboAgent 模式**, starts a pinned Python
TurboAgent environment, reuses the Harness
`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` credential reference without writing the secret to disk, and
registers a hidden `turbo-agent` transport through the official DeepSeek
adapter. The native `deepseek-official` route and its model catalog are not
changed.

@dsh-external/dsh-turbo-agent README · Models：- `DeepSeek-V4-Flash`
- `DeepSeek-V4-Pro`
- `DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp`

Ordinary presets keep their normal model route. Selecting **TurboAgent 模式**
automatically maps the session's official Flash, Pro, or Vision choice to a
hidden Best-of-N route; users do not change the provider or select duplicate
`Verified` models. The hidden provider advertises an empty catalog, so the
model picker continues to show only the three official entries above.

@dsh-external/dsh-turbo-agent README · Models：Each request generates three candidates from the model selected in Harness;
models are never mixed into one candidate pool. Vision requests forward the
same prepared images to every candidate and to
`deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp` for the fine-grained verifier pass. Text-only
requests use DeepSeek V4 Flash as the verifier. Both paths keep the
two-pivot tournament; only text requests use the majority-vote short circuit,
because identical Vision answers still need to be checked against the image.

@dsh-external/dsh-turbo-agent README · Requirements：- Windows 10/11
- Python 3.10 or newer
- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.1-rc.2` or newer compatible release
- A `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` configured in the Harness Models settings

@dsh-external/dsh-turbo-agent README · Install：```powershell
git clone https://github.com/qianen6/dsh-turbo-agent.git
cd dsh-turbo-agent
.\scripts\Install.ps1 -DshCmd 'C:\path\to\dsh.cmd'
```

@dsh-external/dsh-turbo-agent README · Install：The installer creates a repository-local `.venv`, installs the pinned Python
dependency, creates or migrates the non-secret configuration at
`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\turbo-agent\turbo-agent.yaml`, and adds the plugin to the
selected Harness profile and installs the Agent preset. Existing Flash/Pro
candidate and reasoning settings are preserved when the Vision entry is added.
Restart Harness and choose **TurboAgent 模式** from the mode selector.

@dsh-external/dsh-turbo-agent README · Mode settings：Open **Settings → TurboAgent** in Harness to configure:

- Flash candidate concurrency: 1–16
- Pro candidate concurrency: 1–16
- Vision candidate concurrency: 1–16
- Reasoning effort: `off`, `low`, `high`, or `max`

Saving restarts only the managed proxy. Harness and existing conversations stay
online. The values are stored in the non-secret runtime YAML.

@dsh-external/dsh-turbo-agent README · Command-line configuration：Flash, Pro, and Vision are independently configurable from 1 through 16 candidates.
The official self-verification tiers, Best-of-3 and Best-of-5, are included.
For example:

```powershell
.\scripts\Set-TurboAgentCandidates.ps1 -Flash 3 -Pro 5 -Vision 3
.\scripts\Set-TurboAgentCandidates.ps1 -ReasoningEffort max
```

The plugin watches `~/.dsh/turbo-agent/turbo-agent.yaml` and automatically
restarts only the managed proxy after an atomic change; Harness stays running.

@dsh-external/dsh-turbo-agent README · Command-line configuration：Candidate cost grows with the selected count and verification comparisons.
Start with 3; use 5 for the official higher self-verification tier.

@dsh-external/dsh-turbo-agent README · Security：The managed proxy is locked to `127.0.0.1:18888`. The upstream CLI defaults to
`0.0.0.0`; this plugin does not invoke that default. API keys are resolved from
the Harness credential service and passed only in the child-process environment.

TurboAgent traces can contain prompts, responses, and tool arguments. Do not
publish the runtime-data directory. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

@dsh-external/dsh-turbo-agent README · Development：```powershell
node --check lib/index.js
npm test
$env:PYTHONPATH = Join-Path $PWD 'python'
.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m unittest discover -s test -p 'test_*.py' -v
